transformed: IPTC Digital Source Type concepts reduced to stable English identifiers and definitions for local C2PA interpretation.

concepts.label: Algorithmically-altered media
concepts.definition: Modification or correction by algorithm without changing the main content of the media, initiated or configured by a human, such as sharpening or applying noise reduction

concepts.label: Pure algorithmic media
concepts.definition: Media created purely by an algorithm not based on any sampled training data, e.g. an image created by software using a mathematical formula

concepts.label: Composite of elements
concepts.definition: Mix or composite of several elements, any of which may or may not be generative AI

concepts.label: Composite of captured elements
concepts.definition: Mix or composite of several elements that are all captures of real life

concepts.label: Composite including generative AI elements
concepts.definition: Mix or composite of several elements, at least one of which is Generative AI

concepts.label: Edited using Generative AI
concepts.definition: Augmentation, correction or enhancement using a Generative AI model, such as with inpainting or outpainting operations

concepts.label: Multi-frame computational capture sampled from real life
concepts.definition: The media is the result of capturing multiple frames from a real-life source using a digital camera or digital recording device, then automatically merging them into a single frame using digital signal processing techniques and/or non-generative AI. Includes High Dynamic Range (HDR) processing common in smartphone camera apps.

concepts.label: Data-driven media
concepts.definition: Digital media representation of data via human programming or creativity

concepts.label: Digital art
concepts.definition: Media created by a human using digital tools

concepts.label: Digital capture sampled from real life
concepts.definition: The media was captured from a real-life source using a digital camera or digital recording device

concepts.label: Digital creation
concepts.definition: Media created by a human using non-generative tools

concepts.label: Human-edited media
concepts.definition: Augmentation, correction or enhancement by one or more humans using non-generative tools

concepts.label: Original media with minor human edits
concepts.definition: Minor augmentation or correction by a human, such as a digitally-retouched photo used in a magazine

concepts.label: Digitised from a transparent negative
concepts.definition: The media was digitised from a negative on film or other transparent medium

concepts.label: Digitised from a transparent positive
concepts.definition: The media was digitised from a positive on a transparency or other transparent medium

concepts.label: Digitised from a non-transparent medium
concepts.definition: The media was digitised from a non-transparent medium such as a photographic print

concepts.label: Screen capture
concepts.definition: A capture of the contents of the screen of a computer or mobile device

concepts.label: Created by software
concepts.definition: The digital image was created by computer software

concepts.label: Created using Generative AI
concepts.definition: Digital media created algorithmically using an Artificial Intelligence model trained on captured content

concepts.label: Virtual event recording
concepts.definition: Live recording of virtual event based on Generative AI and/or captured elements
